remarks: ALL OFFERS to be submitted by Tuesday, Jan 20 by 5PM. Stunning, move-in-ready tri-level townhome nestled on the banks of the Rippowam River in a sought-after mid-city neighborhood. This home delivers a rare blend of privacy, space and convenience. The main floor includes a garage entrance, foyer, kitchen with hardwood floors and stainless-steel appliances, living room with surround sound, and a dining area. The living room opens to a spacious deck with serene river views. Upstairs offers three generously sized bedrooms with custom closets, including a primary suite with a beautifully updated en-suite bath. The versatile lower level has a beautiful home theatre. Ideal space for a family room, entertainment room, playroom, home office or guest retreat, complete with laundry and a full bathroom. Walk-out to a serene flowing brook. Prime Location - Minutes from Scalzi Park, Mill River, the train station, Merritt Parkway, and I-95, offering tranquility and accessibility
